page: Microsoft Azure DC2ads_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running under Microsoft Hyper-V. The instance provides 2 vCPUs derived from a single physical core with simultaneous multithreading (2 threads per core). It is provisioned with 8.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio (4.0 GB per vCPU), and features 32 MB of L3 cache alongside an 81 GB local SSD for temporary storage. The instance does not include dedicated GPU acceleration or bundled complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results reflect the entry-level compute capacity of a single-core, dual-thread hardware allocation. The instance scored 1981.87 in stress-ng single-core tests, placing in the average middle tier, but multi-core throughput registered in the bottom 10% across the fleet. Similarly, Geekbench metrics produced scores of 1154.0 in single-core and 1390.0 in multi-core testing, with PassMark CPU benchmarks rating at 2340.49 and database operations at 710.55. Redis performance reached 1.66 million SET operations per second, constrained by overall CPU thread concurrency.

From an architectural and cost-efficiency perspective, the DC2ads_v5 offers an entry-tier footprint capable of running standard enterprise utilities without overprovisioning CPU resources. While compute density is naturally limited by the physical single-core allocation, the inclusion of 81 GB of local solid-state storage reduces dependencies on external block volumes for ephemeral files. It represents an efficient baseline for lightweight backend utilities, small development environments, and low-traffic web services where high computational throughput is not required.
description: Microsoft Azure DC2ads_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with 2 vCPUs from a single AMD EPYC 9V74 physical core and 8.0 GB of memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance includes an 81 GB local SSD for ephemeral storage without integrated GPU hardware. Across benchmark suites, the server exhibits baseline compute throughput consistent with its 2-thread footprint, posting 1981.87 in stress-ng single-core testing, a Geekbench multi-core score of 1390.0, and 1.66 million Redis SET operations per second. Hardware cryptographic flags including AES, VAES, and SHA-NI are available. Given the compact physical CPU profile paired with modest local storage, the DC2ads_v5 serves as a cost-efficient general-purpose host for lightweight internal tooling, small databases, staging environments, and entry-level web serving.
